params.caption: Traditional Ethiopian instrumental in the Tizita mode, the mode of memory and longing: a solo masenqo, a single-string bowed fiddle, sings the melody with expressive slides and ornaments over gently plucked krar lyre arpeggios and a soft kebero hand-drum heartbeat. Sparse, slow, intimate and nostalgic, warm live acoustic recording in a small room, no vocals, no synthesizers, no drum kit.

Sparse, slow, intimate and nostalgic, warm live acoustic recording in a small room, no vocals, no synthesizers, no drum kit.

Slow meditative Ethiopian instrumental: a krar lyre plays a hypnotic pentatonic ostinato with plenty of silence between the notes, a warm solo cello pad swells underneath, a soft washint bamboo flute answers in the gaps, faint rain on a tin roof in the background. Intimate and nostalgic, dry close-miked acoustic recording, no vocals, no synthesizers, no drums.

Slow 1970s Addis Ababa Ethio-jazz instrumental: warm vibraphone melody in a pentatonic minor mode, muted upright bass, brushed drums at a gentle pulse, soft Rhodes chords, a wistful bowed fiddle fill now and then. Rainy-afternoon nostalgia, analog tape warmth, spacious and unhurried, no vocals.
